title: Hypergraph Neural Network with State-Space Models for Node Classification
core_idea: Propose HGMN, a model that integrates role-aware representations into GNNs by constructing hypergraphs to capture higher-order relationships and applying state-space modeling. A learnable transformer-like fusion mechanism combines role-based and adjacency-based embeddings; hypergraph convolution layers model complex dependencies, and residual connections mitigate over-smoothing.
tldr: Introduce a hypergraph-based GNN that fuses role-based and adjacency-based features via state-space modeling and a learnable fusion mechanism to produce richer node representations for node classification tasks.
